description:
In this video, I’ll tell you if we are in a correction or not and update you on our latest trade recommendation.

Last month I made a video about the market falling in January.

I got some very naïve comments from newbie traders about how the market could only go up!

It doesn’t and in this video, I’ll tell you what I think about the Nifty right now.

I’ll also provide an update on our latest trade.

Let me know your thoughts. I love to hear from you.

In this video, I’ll tell you if we are in a correction or not and update you on our latest trade recommendation.
